newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Tranz Rail sells locomotives, stock.
newsitem.headline: Tranz Rail sells locomotives, stock.

text.p: Tranz Rail Finance (TRF), part of the Tranz Rail group, said on Friday it had disposed of assets with a gross value in excess of 10 percent of Tranz Rail group's shareholders' funds.
The transactions involve the sale by TRF of locomotives and rolling stock (equipment) to Wilmington Trust Company (a Delaware USA Trust).
The equipment will be contemporaneously leased back to TRF by the Wilmington Trust Company.
TRF will receive on completion a payment of US$93.1 million, which represents the market value of the equipment.
The company said the transaction was in essence an asset-backed financing transaction refinancing borrowing of the Tranz Rail group.
